title: Unembarrassed

inlines.v: UNEMBAR'RASSED, adjective 1. Not embarrassed; not perplexed in mind; not confused. The speaker appeared unembarrassed 2. Free from pecuniary difficulties or incumbrances. He or his property is unembarrassed 3. Free from perplexing connection; as, the question comes before the court unembarrassed with irrelevant matter.
